text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified them and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A protest rally was organised in the cetre of Tetovo over the "mysterious poisoning of Albanian school children". Protesters demanded the resignation of Macedonian health minister Ilija Filipce and interior Minister Tomislav Cokrevski.
- Republic of Macedonia on Friday celebrates the day of national uprising against fascism.

- The still unidentified poisoning in the Tetovo region is detrimental to inter-ethnic relations in Macedonia. Obviously the police is not up to challenges of the new times, says the paper. The Health and education ministires reacting slowly and inadequately.

- Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov on Wednesday received the delegation of Bulgarian company Multigrup led by company head Ilija Pavlov, Bulgarian daily Continent reported. The president's office confirmed this information. (Gligorov's attempted assassination last October was linked to Multigrup which immediately denied the rumor. The Multigrup representative in Macedonia Ivo Jancev committed suicide this spring in Sofia under suspicious circumstances).

- Helsinki human rights committee for Macedonia said hundreds of Macedonian children have been abused on the eve of local elections. "Macedonia is becoming a state in which the abuse of children for political means is more than easy."
